confirmed_current_behavior.desktop_exit: Electron launches the daemon with AO_OWNER=app; the supervisor socket reaches EOF after Electron exits; the backend waits five seconds and requests daemon shutdown; the daemon exits and removes its run-file while durable session/runtime records remain for reconciliation.
confirmed_current_behavior.explicit_daemon_stop: The current explicit daemon:stop path invokes killDaemon and terminates the daemon process group; the existing /shutdown route is not a fact-based safe-stop operation.
confirmed_current_behavior.reload_and_renderer_crash: Renderer transport and terminal attachments reconnect without normally closing the Electron supervisor link or destroying the daemon-owned runtime session.
